ev_0004.summary: Figure: big circle (center O, radius about 236.0) and small circle (center B, radius about 94.5), with B on the big circle. The horizontal solid line runs through O and B, and its ends A and B lie on the big circle, so AB is a diameter and O is its midpoint (coordinates support this: A x=67.43, B x=539.55, O x=303.59). The solid slanted line runs from F (on the big circle) up through E (on the small circle) to C (intersection of the two circles). The CV endpoint at (530.8,166.8) overshoots C by about 13 px. A dashed line passes through B and near E (CV seg_03). No right angle was verified by detect_right_angle_marker, so none is submitted. D and the dashed BC radius are not supported by CV.
